title: Doozy Vape Co Infinity Fizzy Lemon Lime Shortfill E-Liquid 100ml
description: Fizzy Lemon Lime by Doozy Infinity captures the sharp tang of fresh citrus with a lively, effervescent twist. Bright Lemon offers a sweet-sharp citrus base, balanced by the vibrant juiciness of Lime for a layered flavour that zings across the tastebuds. A fizzy finish rounds it all off, giving this unique blend a sparkle that lingers delightfully between draws. This high-VG e-liquid is blended at a 70VG/30PG ratio, making it ideal for Sub-Ohm vaping in advanced kits and powerful DTL (direct-to-lung) devices. Each 120ml shortfill bottle contains 100ml of nicotine-free e-liquid, with space to add two 10ml nic shots to reach your preferred strength. Part of the Doozy Infinity collection, this blend is perfect for vapers who enjoy bold citrus flavour with a sparkling finish and thicker clouds.
